test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement from the given options.

options.text: There is very little temperature difference between day and night in the coastal areas of Kerala.
There is very little temperature difference between day and night in Rajasthan.
There is extreme cold in southern India during winter season.
There is plenty of rain observed in central India throughout the year.

solution:
The correct answer is __**There is very little temperature difference between day and night in the coastal areas of Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** is a state located in the southern part of India, and it is known for its **coastal areas.**
 
• Due to the** proximity of the sea,** the coastal areas of Kerala experience a **moderate climate **with** very little temperature difference **between day and night.
 
• The temperature in Kerala's coastal areas ranges from **20oC to 30oC** throughout the year, making it a popular tourist destination.
 
• The coastal areas of Kerala also receive** heavy rainfall** during the monsoon season, which lasts from** June to September.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajasthan** is a **desert state** located in the **northern part of India** and experiences** extreme temperatures** during summer and winter seasons.
 
• **Central India** is a **semi-arid region** with a **monsoon climate**, and rainfall is limited to the monsoon season.
 
• **India's climate** is characterized by a broad spectrum of weather patterns.
 
 
• According to the **Köppen system**, India has **six main climatic subtypes**: the west has **arid deserts**, the north has **alpine tundra and glaciers,** and the southwest and **island territories** have wet tropical regions that support rain forests.
 
• India's topography and geology play a key role in its climate; the** Himalayas in the north **and the **Thar Desert **in the** northwest **combine to produce a **monsoonal regime** that is significant to **both culture **and the country's economy.
 
• The majority of India can be considered** tropical in climate,** even though the **Tropic of Cancer, **the line between the** tropics and subtropics,** crosses through the center of the nation.
